settlements.caseName: In re Chantix (Varenicline) Marketing, Sales Practices and Products Liability Litigation (No. II)
settlements.summary: A $44 million settlement covers consumers and third-party payors who paid for retail Chantix purchases in the United States from September 29, 2015 through September 17, 2021.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if you paid any amount for retail Chantix in the U.S. or its territories during the class period. This dashboard does not file claims or decide eligibility.
settlements.proofSummary: A Claim Form must be submitted online or postmarked by September 14, 2026. Supporting documents are requested if possible. Opt-out and objection use the same date. Do not submit a claim from this scan.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Consumer payments are pro rata and capped; each consumer claim will not exceed the total amount paid for Chantix. No individual amount is guaranteed.
settlements.administrator: Settlement Administrator supervised by Class Counsel
settlements.court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York, 22-MD-3050 (KPF)
settlements.relevanceReason: Relevant only if the household paid for Chantix during 2015-2021.

settlements.caseName: In re Comcast Cable Communications, LLC Customer Data Security Breach Litigation
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns certain current and former Comcast customers whose personal information was involved in the October 2023 Citrix-related data breach.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if Comcast sent you a notice on or around December 18, 2023 stating that your information was involved in the incident. The administrator must resolve class membership; this dashboard does not file claims.
settlements.proofSummary: Alternative cash claims require the notice credentials or administrator validation. Lost-time and documented-loss claims require truthful details and supporting records as specified by the official form. Do not submit a claim from this scan.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: $50 alternative cash payment; lost time at $30 per hour for up to five hours; documented losses and lost time together may be claimed up to $10,000. Three years of identity-monitoring services are automatic for eligible class members.
settlements.geography: United States and U.S. territories; December 18, 2023 Comcast breach notice required
settlements.court: U.S. District Court, Eastern District of Pennsylvania
settlements.relevanceReason: Nationwide consumer data incident with a September 14 deadline; relevant only after confirming receipt of Comcast's December 18, 2023 breach notice.

settlements.caseName: In re Clark County Data Security Litigation
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns an October 2023 data incident involving certain current and former Clark County, Washington residents.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if you are a qualifying current or former Clark County, Washington resident whose personal information was involved in the incident.
settlements.proofSummary: Review the official notice and claim form for the selected benefit. Do not proceed unless the Clark County connection and affected status are truthful.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Benefit varies by claim type; the official notice controls.
settlements.relevanceReason: Verified and open, but unlikely to fit a Texas household without a prior Clark County connection.

settlements.caseName: Jason Buhl v. Dairy Farmers of America, Inc.
settlements.shortTitle: Dairy Farmers of America data incident settlement
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns a June 2025 Dairy Farmers of America data incident in which certain files with private information may have been accessed.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if your private information was compromised in the June 2025 Dairy Farmers of America data incident. A mailed or emailed notice is a strong signal, but the administrator must resolve eligibility. This dashboard does not file claims.
settlements.proofSummary: The expected $55 alternate cash option states that no proof or explanation is required. Documented-loss claims up to $4,500 require supporting records tied to the incident. The online form uses the LoginID and PIN from the notice; a paper form is also available. Do not submit a claim from this scan.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Expected $55 alternate cash payment, or documented out-of-pocket losses up to $4,500; two years of credit monitoring is also offered.
settlements.geography: United States; class membership is administrator-determined
settlements.administrator: Settlement Administrator for Jason Buhl v. Dairy Farmers of America, Inc.
settlements.court: District Court of Wyandotte County, Kansas, Case No. WY-2026-CV-000143
settlements.relevanceReason: Nationwide consumer data incident; relevant only after confirming notice or affected status.

settlements.caseName: Jones, et al. v. Lands' End, Inc.
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns U.S. residents whose private information was compromised in the December 2024 Lands' End data incident.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if your private information was compromised in the December 2024 incident. A mailed or emailed notice is a strong signal, but the administrator must resolve eligibility.
settlements.proofSummary: The expected $60 alternate cash option states no proof or explanation is required; documented-loss claims up to $5,000 require supporting records. A settlement notice or administrator confirmation may be needed to establish class membership.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Expected $60 alternate cash payment, or documented losses up to $5,000; two years of credit monitoring also offered.
settlements.court: Circuit Court for Iowa County, Wisconsin
settlements.relevanceReason: Nationwide consumer data incident; relevant only after confirming notice or affected status.

settlements.caseName: In re ZF-TRW Airbag Control Units Products Liability Litigation
settlements.summary: A finalized settlement offers benefits to eligible current and former owners or lessees of listed Toyota vehicles.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only to current or former owners or lessees, as of July 31, 2023, of specified 2011-2019 Toyota models. The official VIN lookup determines whether a vehicle is included.
settlements.proofSummary: Vehicle eligibility requires the official VIN lookup. Expense reimbursement needs receipts, invoices, or a signed affidavit; never save a VIN in this dashboard.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Eligible recall expenses may be reimbursed; potential residual distribution is up to $250, plus specified warranty or inspection benefits.
settlements.geography: United States, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and U.S. territories
settlements.court: U.S. District Court, Central District of California
settlements.relevanceReason: Potentially high vehicle value, but only for specific Toyota models and verified VINs.
